convert_moco_model: convert a pycls pretrained moco model checkpoint to mmdet style state dict keys
run_selfsup_converter: run the selfsup2mmdet CLI tool to convert self-supervised model keys for mmdetection
build_moco_checkpoint: build a mmdet-compatible checkpoint from a moco pretrained model source path
test_moco_conversion: test the moco key conversion by stripping module.encoder_q prefix from state dict keys
review_swav_handling: review the swav self-supervised model handling which requires no key conversion
